QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Zombiology
QuestInfo.0: Jonas needs help fighting zombies in the basement of the Haunted Mansion. Talk to the Masked Gentleman to get to him.
QuestInfo.1: Jonas is collecting Zombie Cell Samples for his research on the undead. Double-click on the Decapatruck next to Jonas and help him 'collect samples'.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the cell samples to Jonas and got a Restless Limb Potion in return.\nIt looks dangerous, but somebody's gotta drink it.

0.0: Hey, look, another uppity rich little... wait a second. You don't look rich. You look like a potato farmer!\nYou think you could help me get some stuff? I'm researching these dang old zombies, but it's hard to get away from my lab without them wrecking it.

yes.0: Good to see a little gumption in you young folk! But I don't want you coming back here to eat me, so you probably oughtta take the truck. I don't wanna brag, but it's pretty darn fun.

no.0: I knew you were a spoiled little brat.

1.0: Good samples! I'll have a zombie repellant put together in no time. I whipped you up a Restless Limb Potion while you were out.

item.0: I need a lot more samples!

yes.0: Now watch it, cause that thing's got some kick. You'll be just as tough as one of those zombies. No pain, no fatigue. It's pretty cool!
